source.title: How To Crack Every Summer Party Dress Code
source.author: MR PORTER

tips.text: Plan your outfits ahead for a busy summer social calendar.
tips.why: Packed weeks of events are easy when the right clothes are ready.

tips.text: At a hot destination wedding, choose light, flowing fabrics and easy layers over a heavy suit.
tips.why: Heat and several outfit changes make heavy tailoring impractical.

tips.text: When a summer wedding's dress code is relaxed, a camp-collar shirt with trousers and leather loafers can stand in for a suit.
tips.why: It stays dressed-up while keeping you cool.

tips.text: Cut summer trousers wide enough to let air through and long enough to rest on the shoe.
tips.why: Roomy legs keep you cool and the full length keeps them smart.

tips.text: Bring colour to a wedding outfit through a patterned tie or a bright pocket square.
tips.why: Accessories add personality without overwhelming the tailoring.

tips.text: At summer spectator sport such as tennis, racing or cricket, wear a light unstructured beige blazer, livened up with a colourful shirt or club tie.
tips.why: A pale, light jacket handles heat and suits the daytime setting.

tips.text: As a spectator at a summer tennis event, tennis whites (white polo, white trousers, loafers) are a fitting, practical look.
tips.why: All-white is cool in the heat and nods to the occasion.

tips.text: At an art-gallery party, look well put-together without tipping into overdressed, for example a knitted polo with suit trousers and a soft blazer.
tips.why: Creative events reward effort that doesn't look stiff.

tips.text: At a summer work party, skip the tie unless one is requested and avoid stiff collars.
tips.why: The event should feel relaxed, not like another day at the desk.

tips.text: At a summer work party, wear a blazer only if it is very informal, and choose a low-key shirt over a vest or tank top.
tips.why: Relaxed but never showy or too bare in front of colleagues.

tips.text: For a summer country-house weekend, go preppy: a button-down linen shirt, pleated trousers or shorts, and loafers.
tips.why: Relaxed classic pieces suit the setting.
